facts.meaning: Safari pbStart copies current SAFARI_STEPS(default600) into @steps at46, after @start/ballcount/inProgress writes. This actual lexical read was missing original714 census and is added separately. Each unhandled transfer-capable player-step callback rereads setting at93: skips only if config==0, outsideSafari or decision!=0; otherwise decrements storedsteps, and at<=0 requests two messages, setsdecision1, returns to start, thensets handledtrue. Start does not reset captures/decision; end clears local fields and requests map refresh.
facts.control: Config0 disables this step-counter callback while state may retain an older positive steps value. A negative plugin config is not equivalent to0 guard and can reach exhaustion immediately; legal/default600 behavior remains finite. Priorhandledtrue skips all work.
facts.failure_prefix: Step decrement precedes messages; decision1 precedes transfer; handledtrue is last. Message failure can leave exhausted steps withdecision0, transfer failure can leave decision1 but unhandled. pbGoToStart only acts in Scene_Map; normal no-op outsideScene_Map still lets caller sethandledtrue. Noensure or rollback.
facts.open: Native map transfer, actual callback registration/invocation order and full Safari battle native execution remain separate.

Earlier primary selection may already exceedsize, and numbersPokemon may retain duplicate entries even after numbers index dedup. Finalnumbers sorts, then new trainers/PBPokemon and list metadata are assembled.
